svg.aria-label: Illustration. One: training on a new task, old skills fall as the new one rises. Two: raw data is filtered by hand into datasets and environments. Three: the same request, worded slightly differently, fails.
svg.text: Learn a new skill, lose an old one.
Each dataset and environment, by hand.
Want: learn from raw, real data.
Reply in French: how are you?
Can you say “how are you” in French?
the same request, worded a little differently
Works only when asked just right.
Want: generalise what it was taught.
